brief.creative_description: Create a polished black and gold community recognition programme. Preserve clear areas for a title, portrait, logo and fifteen agenda rows.
brief.title: Community Excellence Awards

programme.title: Welcome by the master of ceremonies

direction.positive_prompt: An elegant, The design features a glossy black background with intricate gold patterns, creating a formal and luxurious atmosphere, and a clean, The visual design maintains a 10mm safe margin on all edges, ensuring clear readability and a polished look
direction.negative_prompt: no readable text, no logos, no portraits, no watermarks, clear space for reserved zones
direction.short_design_rationale: This visual direction emphasizes sophistication and elegance, reflecting the high regard for community excellence. The black and gold theme aligns with the event's luxurious and formal setting, making it memorable and impactful.

direction.positive_prompt: Dramatic black velvet background with shimmering gold filigree patterns, Rich, dark atmosphere, Sophisticated and regal, Baroque style ornamentation, Soft, diffused lighting creating depth and texture, Elegant, flowing lines, Subtle, abstract shapes suggesting celebration and achievement, Deep shadows and highlights, A sense of timelessness
direction.negative_prompt: bright colors, flat design, minimalism, cartoonish, simple shapes, modern, gradients, photography, text, writing, logos, portraits, illustrations
direction.short_design_rationale: This direction utilizes a luxurious black and gold palette to convey the community's excellence and recognition. The baroque filigree evokes a sense of history and prestige, creating a polished and sophisticated look. The velvet texture and dramatic lighting enhance the overall atmosphere of celebration.

direction.positive_prompt: Use a geometric, clean, and modern aesthetic with a focus on elegance and community recognition, Incorporate subtle gold accents and textures to convey prestige and refinement, Ensure the composition is balanced and symmetrical, with an atmospheric lighting to emphasize the importance of the occasion, The background should feature a luxurious and polished style, evoking a sense of community excellence
direction.negative_prompt: Do not include any text, logos, portraits, or readable characters. Avoid bright colors or overly busy patterns.
direction.short_design_rationale: The design aims to capture the essence of community excellence and recognition through a refined and polished black and gold aesthetic. The use of geometric patterns and subtle gold accents evokes a sense of prestige and elegance, fitting for an event that honors achievements. The clean, modern composition ensures clarity and focus on the event's significance.
